basic_details.short_information: One post of Member Secretary in the Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (Krishi Lagat evam Mulya Aayog, CACP) is to be filled on deputation (including short-term contract) for five years at Level-14 of the Pay Matrix (Rs. 1,44,200-2,18,200). The post is open to serving officers only: applications must be forwarded through proper channel to Shri Ajit Kumar, Under Secretary, Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Room No. 342, Krishi Bhawan, New Delhi-110001, within 60 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News. content_sections.heading: About CACP
content_sections.text: The Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP) is an attached office under the administrative control of the Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India. The recruitment is handled by the Economics and Statistics (Establishment) Section of the Department at Krishi Bhawan, New Delhi. The circular is addressed to the Secretaries of Central Government Ministries and Departments, the Secretaries (Agriculture) and Secretaries (Planning) of all State Governments and Union Territories, and the Registrars of all agricultural universities.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Shri Ajit Kumar, Under Secretary [Economics and Statistics (Establishment) Section], Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Room No. 342, Krishi Bhawan, New Delhi-110001 Fill in the bio-data proforma (Annexure-I) attached to the circular, in three copies. The proforma can also be downloaded from the Department's recruitment page, https://agriwelfare.gov.in/knowledge?type=Recruitment . Sign the declaration on the proforma and write your address below the signature. Attach the documents listed under Enclosures below. Submit the application to your employer or cadre controlling authority, so that it goes through proper channel. The forwarding authority verifies and certifies that the information given by the officer is correct, and the head of department countersigns the certificate in the prescribed format (page 10 of the proforma). The forwarding authority sends the application to the address above within the deadline. Contact given in the circular: Shri Ajit Kumar, Under Secretary, telephone 23383160, email [email protected] . Applications are sent by post, not by email.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The single post is Member Secretary at Level-14 of the Pay Matrix (Rs. 1,44,200-2,18,200), to be filled on deputation (including short-term contract) basis for a period of five years. An applicant must meet route (I) or route (II). (I) Officers of the Indian Economic Service or the Indian Statistical Service: (i) holding analogous posts on regular basis; or (ii) with three years' regular service in Level-13 of the Pay Matrix or equivalent posts (including service in a higher post), and one year's experience in that grade. OR (II) Officers under the Central Government, State Governments, universities, agricultural universities or recognised research institutes who hold analogous posts on regular basis, or who have completed three years' regular service in Level-13 of the Pay Matrix or equivalent posts, and who possess: (i) Ph.D. in Agricultural Economics or Agricultural Statistics from a recognised university; and (ii) twelve years' teaching or research experience in various aspects of agriculture, including agricultural price policy, production economics and agricultural trade policy; and (iii) ability to apply quantitative techniques; and (iv) experience in government administration. According to the application proforma, only officers under the Central or State Governments are eligible for absorption, and candidates from non-government organisations are eligible for short-term contract. The maximum age for appointment on deputation or short-term contract should not exceed 56 years as on the closing date for receipt of applications. The officer selected on deputation will have the option either to draw own grade pay/level pay plus deputation (duty) allowance, or to have pay fixed in the pay scale of the post, as per the Department of Personnel and Training Office Memoranda No. 2/22(B)/2008-Estt.(Pay-II) dated 3 September 2008, No. 2/22/2008-Estt.(Pay-II) dated 3 November 2009, No. 6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010, No. 2/11/2017-Estt.(Pay-II) dated 24.11.2017 and No. DOPT-1711629234974 dated 28.03.2024, as amended from time to time. The period of deputation, including any short-term contract in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment in the same or another organisation or department of the Central Government, shall ordinarily not exceed five years. For the full wording of each eligibility condition, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: CACP Member Secretary Job Description
content_sections.text: The circular lists these duties of the Member Secretary, CACP: Performing the administrative functions of the Commission and assisting the Chairman as Head of Department in financial and administrative matters of the Commission. Assisting the Commission in work related to price policy of agricultural commodities. Participating in the deliberations and meetings of the Commission. Advising or informing the Chairman on any issue in the interest of the Commission. Accompanying the Commission during field visits. Undertaking research and analytical work in areas agreed by the Commission and approved by the Chairman. Providing an interface between the Commission and the rest of the world. Supervising and guiding the work of the technical divisions of the Commission.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Only applications sent through proper channel with these documents will be considered: Bio-data in the attached proforma (three copies). Photocopies of the Annual Confidential Reports / Annual Performance Appraisal Reports of the last five years, each page attested (signed and stamped) by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary to the Government of India. Integrity certificate. Certificate stating that no vigilance case is pending or contemplated against the officer. No-penalty certificate stating that no major or minor penalty has been imposed, or a statement of major or minor penalties, if any, imposed on the officer during the last ten years. If the applicant's organisation does not follow Central Government pay scales, the latest pay slip issued by the organisation, showing basic pay with pay scale and rate of increment, dearness allowance or interim relief and other allowances, and total emoluments. Certificate by the employer or cadre controlling authority (with seal) that the details are correct, that the officer will be relieved immediately if selected, that no vigilance or disciplinary case is pending, that integrity is certified, and that the ACR dossier or attested ACR copies are attached.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made by a Search-cum-Selection Committee duly constituted as per the guidelines of the Department of Personnel and Training. The Committee will have the right to shortlist candidates for the post on the basis of experience, qualifications and other factors, and to call them for a personal discussion. The proforma's declaration states that the information in the bio-data, supported by documents on essential qualification and work experience, will be assessed by the selection committee.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CACP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one post of Member Secretary in the Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the CACP Member Secretary application?
faq.answer: Applications must be forwarded within 60 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News; applications received after the last date will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for CACP Member Secretary?
faq.answer: IES or ISS officers holding analogous posts or with three years' regular service in Level-13 may apply; other government, university or research institute officers also need a Ph.D. in Agricultural Economics or Agricultural Statistics, twelve years' teaching or research experience, quantitative skills and government administration experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the CACP Member Secretary post?
faq.answer: The maximum age should not exceed 56 years as on the closing date for receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of CACP Member Secretary?
faq.answer: The post is at Level-14 of the Pay Matrix (Rs. 1,44,200-2,18,200), and the selected officer may opt to draw own pay plus deputation (duty) allowance or to have pay fixed in the pay scale of the post.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the CACP Member Secretary post?
faq.answer: Send the bio-data proforma in three copies with the listed documents through proper channel to Shri Ajit Kumar, Under Secretary, Room No. 342, Krishi Bhawan, New Delhi-110001.

faq.question: Q7. How will the CACP Member Secretary be selected?
faq.answer: A Search-cum-Selection Committee constituted as per DoPT guidelines may shortlist candidates on the basis of experience and qualifications and call them for a personal discussion.

faq.question: Q8. Is the CACP Member Secretary post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the post is filled on deputation (including short-term contract) for a period of five years.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from non-government organisations apply?
faq.answer: According to the application proforma, candidates from non-government organisations are eligible for short-term contract, while only Central or State Government officers are eligible for absorption.

faq.question: Q10. What should an officer already on deputation do?
faq.answer: The application of an officer already on deputation should be sent by the parent cadre or department along with cadre clearance, vigilance clearance and integrity certificate.
